event_summary: A blue upright rectangular prism on a circular base remains in place while its visible faces and the dark wall silhouette gradually change.
raw_event_description: The video shows a tabletop scene with a circular base holding a vertical blue rectangular prism in front of a wall illuminated by a large round light patch. A dark vertical-and-horizontal silhouette is visible on the wall behind and left of the prism. Through the clip, the prism stays upright on the base with no visible translation, while the visible blue face and dark side edge change gradually. The wall silhouette also changes gradually in width, edge shape, and position relative to the bright patch. The tabletop, wall, cable, and circular base position appear unchanged.

reasons: The upright blue prism, circular base, tabletop, wall, and wall silhouette are visible from the first frame.
The first frame already shows the ongoing arrangement with no separate start action visible.
Lighting is dim outside the illuminated wall patch but the main objects are distinguishable.
